text: With no visible threat or opportunities allegedly in sight, the Princes cut the costs and allow most of their captains to be hired elsewhere en masse. This brings huge savings, but until the lease and the gamble is over, the City-States are vulnerable...
The conflicts ahead require that the only troops fielded are going to be the very best the treasury can afford.
The upcoming enterprises require masses. The Princes have agreed that drowning the common enemy in bodies is the reasonable strategy here, no matter the drop in average troop quality.
Master Duellist Contract cannot be renewed.
Master Duellists can be recruited factionwide and with increased rank.
Hireling Battle Wizard Contract cannot be renewed.
Hireling Battle Wizards can be recruited factionwide and with increased rank.
